name: GL_FRC_REPORTS_B
description: This table contains the list of reports available in BI catalog. This includes all the 3 types of reports namely BIP, OTBI and Financial Report.

columns.name: REPORT_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for each report in catalog.

columns.name: REPORT_FOLDER
columns.description: Path of the folder in which the report is stored in the catalog.

columns.name: REPORT_PATH
columns.description: Complete path of the report which is returned by the BI webservice.

columns.name: REPORT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the report. Valid Values are BIP, Dashboard, Analysis and FR.

columns.name: REPORT_DISPLAY_ICON
columns.description: Holds the display icon path associated with each report type.

columns.name: REPORT_IMAGE_PATH
columns.description: Holds the report image path which would be displayed as an image on the reporting center user interface.

columns.name: BIP_REPORT_JOB_DEFINITION
columns.description: Holds the ESS Job definition of a BIP report. This column will be populated only if the report type is BIP.

columns.name: AUTHOR_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display name of user who created the report in business intelligence catalog.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when report was last modfied in business intelligence catalog.

columns.name: LAST_ACCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when report was last accessed in business intelligence catalog.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
